script_text: Aquarius, the cosmos is about to shake your world this week. On Monday, Uranus your ruler squares Saturn in your 7th House, creating tension in partnerships, while Venus in your 5th House trines the Moon, igniting romantic chemistry. Tuesday brings a Mercury opposition to Neptune in your 10th House, clouding career decisions and making Wednesday the optimal day for negotiations. Mid‑week, the Sun conjoins Mars in your 1st House, marking a bold turning point that propels you forward. By Thursday, Jupiter in your 9th House offers expansive travel ideas, and the weekend sees a harmonious sextile between your Air‑sign chart and the Moon in your 4th House, promising cozy family time. Your power day is Wednesday, when Venus enters your 5th House, while Tuesday is your worst day due to the Mercury‑Neptune opposition. Focus on clear communication and avoid impulsive investments. Follow for daily updates.
